INSERT INTO `msklad-bi-prod.core.dim_fx_rates` (date, rate_kgs_per_usd)
SELECT
  missing_date,
  last_rate.rate_kgs_per_usd
FROM (
  SELECT d AS missing_date
  FROM UNNEST(
    GENERATE_DATE_ARRAY(
      DATE_ADD((SELECT MAX(date) FROM `msklad-bi-prod.core.dim_fx_rates`), INTERVAL 1 DAY),
      CURRENT_DATE()
    )
  ) AS d
) gaps
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT rate_kgs_per_usd
  FROM `msklad-bi-prod.core.dim_fx_rates`
  ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1
) last_rate
WHERE gaps.missing_date NOT IN (
  SELECT date FROM `msklad-bi-prod.core.dim_fx_rates`
);

    FROM `msklad-bi-prod.core.dim_fx_rates`

        SELECT 1 FROM `msklad-bi-prod.core.dim_fx_rates` WHERE date = DATE('2026-05-19')

MERGE `msklad-bi-prod.core.dim_fx_rates` T
    USING (
        SELECT DATE('2026-06-03') AS date,
               CAST(87.45 AS FLOAT64)          AS rate_kgs_per_usd
    ) S
    ON T.date = S.date
    WHEN MATCHED THEN
        UPDATE SET T.rate_kgs_per_usd = S.rate_kgs_per_usd
    WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN
        INSERT (date, rate_kgs_per_usd) VALUES (S.date, S.rate_kgs_per_usd)
